blocks.text: MANILA, PHILIPPINES — Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III is pushing for a more comprehensive and coordinated government approach to help former inmates rebuild their lives. Senate Bill No. 2281, or the proposed National Reintegration Act seeks to establish a national framework for the reintegration of Persons Restored of Liberty (PRLs) into society through employment, housing, education, healthcare, and psychosocial support. The measure highlights the need to look beyond incarceration and recognize the importance of preparing people for life after prison.
